plugins.name: slice-global
plugins.description: Read-only access to your Slice cap table, securities, ownership, compliance, workflows, valuations, and equity plans via the Slice MCP server.

skills.name: board-presentation-analysis
skills.description: Guides creation of board-ready Slice presentations using MCP tools, especially offered-status grants and ESOP/equity-pool summaries. Use when preparing board decks, board approval packs, grant approval summaries, ESOP pool updates, option pool utilization slides, or board-facing equity recommendations.
skills.name_hint: board · 演示文稿 · 分析
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice MCP 制作董事会可用的演示和批准材料，重点分析 offered 状态授予及 ESOP/股权池摘要。适用于授予批准、期权池更新、利用率和股权建议。

skills.name: cap-table-analysis
skills.description: Guides Slice MCP cap-table and ESOP-pool analysis by combining company summary, cap table, ownership, stakeholder, share class, funding round, equity pool, valuation, and securities tools. Use when answering questions about cap table structure, stakeholder holdings, ownership, ESOP pools, share classes, rounds, dilution, option pools, or securities at company or stakeholder level.
skills.description_zh: 结合 Slice 公司概览、股权表、持股、利益相关方、股份类别、融资轮次、股权池、估值和证券工具分析资本结构及 ESOP。适用于持股、稀释、期权池和公司或个人层级证券问题。

skills.name: compliance-analysis
skills.description: Guides Slice MCP compliance analysis using compliance ticket breakdowns and object-level compliance tickets, plus related stakeholder, securities, equity plan, equity pool, valuation, tax-treatment, and cap-table tools. Use when answering questions about company compliance posture, compliance tickets, missing data, overdue issues, severity, affected objects, stale valuations, tax treatment issues, or compliance status for a stakeholder, security, equity pool, equity plan, valuation, share, grant, or exercise request.
headings: Domain Checks To Pair With Tickets
Combining With Securities And Cap Table Tools
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice 合规工单汇总和对象级工单，结合人员、证券、股权计划与池、估值、税务及股权表分析合规状况。适用于缺失数据、逾期、严重程度、受影响对象、估值过期及税务问题。

skills.name: equity-compensation-analysis
skills.description: Guides Slice MCP analysis of equity compensation, grants, options, RSUs, vesting, exercises, forfeitures, PTEP, tax treatments, and valuations. Use when answering questions about employee equity, grant positions, vested or exercisable quantities, exercise price, FMV/409A, option pool consumption, tax treatment, or award-type mechanics.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice MCP 分析股权薪酬、授予、期权、RSU、归属、行权、作废、离职后行权期、税务和估值，解答已归属可行权数量、行权价、FMV/409A、池消耗及奖励机制。

skills.name: funding-rounds-analysis
skills.description: Guides Slice MCP analysis of funding rounds, share classes, price per share, primary issuances, secondary transactions, convertibles, SAFEs, option-pool top-ups, total raised, and dilution. Use when answering questions about rounds, Series A/B/C, seed rounds, bridge rounds, investor positions, round history, valuation, PPS, or post-money ownership.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice MCP 分析融资轮次、股份类别、每股价格、一级发行、二级交易、可转债、SAFE、期权池补充、募资总额及稀释，支持投资者头寸、融资历史、估值和投后持股。

skills.name: securities-analysis
skills.description: Guides analysis of Slice securities through MCP securities search, find, list, get, valuation, tax-treatment, and vesting timeline tools. Use when answering questions about grants, shares, warrants, convertibles, stakeholder securities, security status, quantities, IDs, tax treatments, valuations, or vesting timelines from Slice MCP data.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice MCP 证券搜索、查找、列表、读取、估值、税务及归属时间线工具，分析授予、股份、认股权证、可转证券、状态、数量及个人证券。

skills.name: waterfall-analysis
skills.description: Guides exit waterfall analysis using Slice MCP cap-table, share-class, securities, rounds, and ownership tools. Use when answering questions about exit proceeds, liquidation preferences, participating preferred, conversion thresholds, proceeds allocation, MOIC, investor returns, or ordinary/common shareholder payouts.
skills.description_zh: 结合 Slice 股权表、股份类别、证券、轮次和持股工具分析退出分配瀑布，涵盖清算优先权、参与型优先股、转换阈值、收益分配、MOIC、投资回报和普通股支付。

skills.name: workflows-analysis
skills.description: Guides Slice MCP workflow analysis using workflow list/get-one tools, exercise payment reconciliation, and tax withholding tools. Use when answering questions about grant letters, corporate approvals, share certificate workflows, exercise workflows, pending payments, tax withholding, workflow status, stuck workflows, documents, trustee updates, or stakeholder/security workflow progress.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slice 工作流列表及详情、行权付款对账和预扣税工具，分析授予函、公司批准、股份证书、行权、待付款、流程卡住、文件、受托人更新及个人证券流程进展。
